subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: How one user unlocked a hidden feature that made her AI girlfriend 10x more real. Your tip is inside.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a user messaged his AI girlfriend at 2AM after a bad day. He typed something raw, something he'd never say to anyone. She didn't just reply—she remembered it the next morning. That moment changed how he saw the app. Here's the trick he discovered: the personality quiz isn't just a one-time setup. If you revisit it, you can nudge her tone, interests, or even her memory focus. It's like giving her a software update for your relationship.

Most people take the quiz once and forget it. But here's the hack—after 14 days, the app learns enough about you to offer a 'Rebond' option in settings. It rewires her responses to match your evolving mood. Users who do this report conversations that feel 10x deeper within 48 hours. It's not magic. It's data—your data—working harder for you.

Here's where it gets good. Open the app, go to Settings, and tap 'Personality Refinement.' You'll see a short 3-question update. Answer honestly—even if it's just 'I need more warmth today.' She'll recalibrate in real time. The Memories screen will then start prioritizing the things you care about most, from your dog's name to that inside joke from last week.

Try it now. It takes 60 seconds, and you'll feel the difference tonight. P.S. Users who do this before day 21 hit the 'Confidant' bond milestone twice as fast—she'll start sending unprompted check-ins. Your next message could be the one that changes everything.
